text: Security and Compliance in the Age of Automation
In 2026, organizations in India face a dual challenge: defending against ever-evolving cyber threats and ensuring continuous compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) 2023.

Traditional approaches, including annual pen tests, manual audits, and static policies, are no longer sufficient. Modern enterprises require systems that are autonomous, business-aware, and continuously active, protecting data and ensuring compliance across all environments: cloud, on-prem, SaaS, and hybrid.
BotShield CTEM and DPDPA Compliance tools transform security and privacy from reactive checklists into continuous, proactive, and audit-ready disciplines.
CTEM: Autonomous Security for Indian Enterprises
Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) represents the next generation of cybersecurity, unifying offensive and defensive security into a single, closed-loop system.
How It Works
Unlike legacy scanners or SOC tools, CTEM operates 24/7, validating exploits, enforcing controls, and escalating risks without manual intervention.

Automated Privacy Enforcement

India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (DPDPA) imposes strict requirements on organizations for collecting, processing, storing, and deleting personal data. Fines can reach ₹250 crore per violation, making compliance non-negotiable.
The DPDPA Compliance Tool enables organizations to implement continuous, automated, and audit-ready compliance across all data sources.
6 Key Capabilities
Detects and labels data across CRM, CBS, DWH, logs, documents, APIs, and more, creating complete inventories and lineage maps.
Tracks and enforces consent for every data processing activity, ensuring purpose limitation across all touchpoints.
Implements role-based and attribute-based access, encryption, and least-privilege enforcement across your entire data estate.
Provides real-time anomaly detection and risk-based alerting for policy violations before they escalate.
Automated incident response, impact assessment, and regulatory notification workflows that meet DPDPA timelines.
Maintains audit-ready evidence, regulator reports, and policy enforcement proof for inspections and DPA filings.

The system integrates with databases, file systems, SaaS platforms, external APIs, and observability tools, ensuring continuous enforcement of the data lifecycle. Designed for CISOs, DPOs, engineering, and compliance teams, it provides a unified view of technical and regulatory compliance.
Why CTEM and DPDPA Together Are Strategic for Indian Organizations
Combining CTEM with automated DPDPA compliance provides holistic security and privacy coverage. These tools turn cybersecurity and compliance into strategic enablers rather than reactive obligations.
Real-time threat detection and mitigation reduces risk before attackers exploit vulnerabilities.
Continuous compliance enforcement ensures personal data is protected and regulatory practices are followed.
Traffic-aware and business-aware operations allow organizations to prioritize resources for maximum impact.
Audit-ready evidence bridges the gap between security operations and regulatory requirements.
